appearance_facts.fact: Title 'Top Product Lines: Ad Spend vs Sales' in bold black text near the top of the page.
Five blue circular markers are arranged diagonally from lower-left to upper-right, each with a text label above it.
Line A marker is the lowest and leftmost point, positioned near the bottom-left corner of the data cloud.
Line E marker is the highest and rightmost point, positioned near the top-right corner of the data cloud.
Line B, Line C, and Line D markers lie between Line A and Line E, forming a roughly linear ascending pattern.
A vertical y-axis on the left and a horizontal x-axis at the bottom frame the plot area with black tick marks.
The plot background is a very light blue/white with no gridlines or reference lines visible.
